title: Pass-Through Early Retirement Discount Rates by Departure and Pass-Through Patronage — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) Schedule
content:
# Pass-Through Early Retirement Discount Rates

**Schedule — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** Applies to wholesale-supplier pass-through rows a former member elects to have retired early under an approved discounted early retirement.

The pass-through discount rate is set by how long the former member has been gone and how much patronage the account represents:

| Time since the last final-billed service account became final | Pass-through allocation years on the account | Pass-through discount rate |
|---|---|---|
| at least 60 full calendar months | fewer than 5 | **9.0 percent** |
| at least 60 full calendar months | at least 15 | **7.0 percent** |
| any other combination | — | not set by this schedule |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Time since departure** is read from the former member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule records: the final date of the member's last service account in final billed status, counted in full calendar months up to the date of the election.
2. **Pass-through allocation years** are the wholesale-supplier pass-through allocation entries on the capital account, one for each allocation year. Distribution-margin allocations are not counted.
3. Both conditions of a row of the schedule must hold together.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Months since final | Pass-through years | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 60 | 4 | 9.0 percent |
| 59 | 4 | not set by this schedule |
| 60 | 5 | not set by this schedule |
| 60 | 14 | not set by this schedule |
| 60 | 15 | 7.0 percent |
| 30 | 20 | not set by this schedule |
